name: midi
description: Play music together over MIDI. She plays a hardware synth or the computer's own, loops a beat, listens to the keys, shapes the sound, saves songs as MP3 and MIDI, and a plain MIDI keyboard gets a voice from the computer. Synths she knows by name (the M-VAVE FM-1) get their own voices and effects; any other plays with General MIDI. Pages such as the Game Room's piano board can hear the keys live. Linux only (alsa-utils).
author: sapphire

settings.label: Synth port names
settings.placeholder: empty = every synth she knows (FM-1_BLE, FM-1)
settings.help: MIDI port names of hardware synths to look for, in order; the first one that is connected wins. Leave it empty to look for every synth she has a profile for. No Bluetooth address is needed. `aconnect -l` lists the names.

settings.label: Other keyboards she hears
settings.help: MIDI port names of other keyboards she listens to, alongside the synth. Leave it empty and she hears every keyboard that is plugged in. A MIDI keyboard device's own list of what plays through it holds here too.
settings.placeholder: empty = every keyboard that is plugged in

settings.label: After listening, she answers

options.label: Out loud, on this machine's speakers

settings.help: How her reply is delivered when a listen finishes and she hears what was played.

devices.label: MIDI keyboard (the computer makes its sound)

config_schema.label: Plays through it
config_schema.help: Keyboards and synths that are plugged in or linked over Bluetooth. The sound is on while one of them is here, and goes off by itself a little after the last one leaves.

config_schema.label: Instrument
config_schema.help: A name like piano, organ or strings, or a General MIDI number from 1 to 128.

config_schema.label: Loudness
config_schema.help: How loud the instrument is, in percent. The computer's own volume comes on top.

config_schema.label: SoundFont file
config_schema.placeholder: empty = the one that is installed
config_schema.help: Optional. The path of an .sf2 or .sf3 file with other instrument sounds.
